notes: Performance - Specifications (Continued), printed page iii/iv: MAXIMUM WEIGHT Ramp 3614 POUNDS, Takeoff 3600 POUNDS, Landing 3600 POUNDS; STANDARD EMPTY WEIGHT 2197 POUNDS; MAXIMUM USEFUL LOAD 1417 POUNDS.
The handbook computes maximum useful load against maximum ramp weight (3614 lb), not maximum takeoff weight (3600 lb): 3614 - 2197 = 1417.
Standard empty weight is the handbook figure for a standard-equipped airplane. Each airplane's own weighed basic empty weight, from its weight-and-balance record, governs.
corrections_applied: FD-760 (2026-09-26): empty_weight 2150 -> 2197 and useful_load 1450 -> 1417. The previous figures cited no handbook.

notes: Loading arrangements give pilot/front passenger FS 37 (32-43), centre passengers FS 70 (69-79), aft passengers FS 100 (94-100), baggage FS 127.
Baggage area is station 109 to 145, 180 lb maximum. Usable fuel C.G. arm is FS 46.5.

baggage_arm_2 (136.0 in) is not a station the handbook publishes; it lies inside the 109-145 baggage area and aft of its published 127 in arm, so it cannot understate an aft loading. Kept because the station key set is the clients' W&B vocabulary (FD-325).
